text: SOUL Q&A offers `soul_ask` (persona-only), `soul_qdcvr_ask` (retrieve-then-persona with PAS score), and `soul_router` (auto-routing). Experience meditation spawns an agent harness (`omp -p`/`claude -p`) as a subprocess; the backend only records runs. A circuit breaker trips after 3 consecutive failures (24 h cooldown); unavailable harnesses degrade to mechanical extraction (confidence=0.3); auto-extracted, unvetted experiences stay drafts, capped at P1. Signals live in `storage/meditation.db` (SQLite/WAL). Vector indexing (L4): one KB → one `kb_{kb_id}` collection, one doc → N `{doc_path}__chunk_{index}` chunks, BGE-M3 embeddings (1024-dim), chunk_size=500, chunk_overlap=50, score_threshold=0.35; missing ChromaDB falls back to BM25. The L5 knowledge graph uses Neo4j with `graph_doc_id` keys and `transformers` NER, optional via `ragctl up --no-neo4j`. Testing splits hermetic unit tests from MinerU integration; `validate_skills.cjs` runs 8 cross-skill checks.
